name: Intensive Castration Scheme
benefit: - **Financial Assistance:** An amount of ₹500/- subsidy per animal (male calf) for castration by close method (Burdizo Castrator)/open method (Surgical Method).
_eligibility_text:
- The applicant must be an individual livestock owner or an animal-rearing organization (Gaushala/Panjarapol/others).
  - The male calf must be castrated through the close or open method.
